summary: RoCEnante reports whether a rank is inside a collective, and a timeout at sequence 0 poisons
compatibility: No user action required. Only multi-node RoCEnante changes.
details: The last block to finish a collective mirrors its epoch into host memory, and snapshot() returns the control record, every peer's delivered flags and the proxy counters from pinned host memory only, so a watchdog can read it while a kernel is wedged.
A timeout now sets a dedicated failed word. Before, a timeout at sequence 0 recorded 0, which read as healthy.
The system-scope spin's result register is early-clobber, so the compiler cannot assign it the register of an input still being read.
